# Storskogen och RVRC rapporterar – Nvidia i nytt samarbete

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börsfrukost (11 Aug 2026) covers Q4 for RevolutionRace (RVRC) — a 3% local-currency growth miss driven by flat Germany and a deliberate US pullback, sending the stock down 11-12% at open — versus a steadier acquisitive Storskogen with 5% organic growth that hosts view as a small step forward on a low valuation. Macro backdrop is cautious: high oil, rising long rates pressuring equities, and questions over Nvidia's move to mobilise $500bn of third-party, debt-financed AI-infrastructure capital. Defence name Saab stands out on a Barclays upgrade.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RVRC — RevolutionRace (RVRC) | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Weak 3% growth, flat Germany (>half of sales), deliberate US retreat; but strong Nordics, 21% EBIT margin, strong net cash, raised dividend, gaining market share.

#### Reasoning

Hosts expect the market to punish the soft growth (stock -11-12%), and tough comps loom into Q1. But structurally the CEO argues Nordics grow well, Switzerland/Austria +20%, high margins and balance-sheet strength fund the I Can I Will acquisition. It is a share-gain story stalled by German macro and tariff-driven US pullback rather than a broken model — a wait-for-growth-inflection name.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Germany stays flat/declines another quarter
- if Nordic growth decelerates
- if margins fall below peers
- if US tariff situation worsens

> *"Jag tror marknaden kommer ta fasta på den svaga tillväxten i den här rapporten. Det här var en aktie som straffades redan förra kvartalet."*

---

### 🟢 STOR-B — Storskogen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q2 in line, 5% organic growth, stable margin, debt reduction lifting pre-tax and net profit; low valuation after a tough multi-year turnaround.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call it a small step forward: double-digit... i.e. stable growth and margin, weak-looking cash flow well explained by end-of-quarter industry orders that reverse when paid. Operating profit flat but sharply reduced debt drives a nice increase in profit before tax and EPS. Given low valuation post a super-tough journey, hosts see it as slightly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth turns negative
- if working-capital/cash conversion doesn't recover
- if margin erodes below 9.7%
- if debt reduction stalls

> *"givet att de har ganska låg värdering efter att ha haft en supertuff resa senaste åren, så tycker jag det här är ett litet fall framåt."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Stock up ~4% against a down market; Barclays upgrade to overweight from underweight; RBC initiates at sector perform, 600 SEK target.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst catalysts: Barclays flips from underweight to overweight while RBC starts coverage at sector perform with a 600 SEK target. The stock is the strongest on the large-cap list, moving against a weak tape — positive analyst-driven momentum for the defence name, though RBC's neutral rating tempers conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence-spending momentum reverses
- if analysts downgrade
- if price exceeds 600 SEK target

> *"Saab gå mot strömmen upp över fyra. Där har Barclays höjt rekommendationen till övervikt från tidigare undervikt."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Stock -3%; enabling AI datacenter buildout via >$500bn third-party, increasingly debt-financed capital to sustain chip demand — raises return-on-investment concerns.

#### Reasoning

Hosts frame Nvidia as backstopping the entire AI infrastructure buildout to keep chip demand high, a smart move but one that raises questions as huge capex shifts from customers' own cash flows to borrowed money and must eventually generate returns. Amid concentration risk on Wall Street, it is a name to monitor rather than a clear directional call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI datacenter demand softens
- if debt-financed capex fails to show returns
- if broader tech concentration unwinds

> *"Smart men det väcker också frågor när man lånefinansierar enorma capexinvesteringar."*

---

### ⛔ FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Outdoor peer heavily exposed to Germany falling further after a steep multi-year decline; weak German market weighs on the whole segment.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned as an industry peer contaminating sentiment: with Germany a key market, Fenix falls further on the same German softness hitting RVRC, and hosts note it has had a very steep decline for several years. Framed negatively as evidence the German outdoor market is sluggish — a cautious/avoid tone rather than a researched call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German outdoor demand recovers
- if the multi-year downtrend stabilizes

> *"branschkonkurrenten Fenix Outdoor som också har Tyskland som en viktig marknad faller ytterligare lite. De har ju haft en väldigt brant nedgång i flera år nu"*

---
